sources.setup: plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world (floor top at y -60), difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed, natural regeneration off; two bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5) and Viewer at (4.5,-60,4.5), which records BDS's copy of Subject from the MovePlayer relays; script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py; /tp of Subject 8 blocks along z, the client following it at once, 1, 5 or 30 inputs late, never, or acknowledging it without moving (orders teleports follow|late N|ignore|fake), with corrections followed or ignored (corrections follow|ignore), walking (move 1 0) in between, and /kill respawns followed and ignored

plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world (floor top at y -60), difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed, natural regeneration off; two bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5) and Viewer at (4.5,-60,4.5), which records BDS's copy of Subject from the MovePlayer relays; script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py; Subject standing still and reporting its position offset from its own simulation (order offset DX DY DZ, thousandths) by 0.2, 0.45 and 0.55 along z, (0.4, 0.4) in x and z, 0.4, 0.6 and -0.3 in y, 0.2 while walking, then 1.0, 0.3 and 0.6 with corrections ignored

plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world (floor top at y -60), difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed, natural regeneration off; two bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5) and Viewer at (4.5,-60,4.5), which records BDS's copy of Subject from the MovePlayer relays; script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py; a stone wall x 12, y -60..-57, z -3..3 and a one-block step at x 20, y -60, z -3..3; Subject reporting scripted positions (order walk): 0.4 a tick east (speed), 0.2 a tick into the wall (phase), a 1-block step up, hovering after a /tp 5 blocks up (fly), a 0.3-a-tick rise (high jump), a fall from 10 blocks claiming the ground every input (hold verticalcollision: no-fall) and a slow descent claimed while falling; with corrections followed and ignored

plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world (floor top at y -60), difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed, natural regeneration off; two bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5) and Viewer at (4.5,-60,4.5), which records BDS's copy of Subject from the MovePlayer relays; script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py; Subject standing still and reporting offsets of 0.09 and 0.11 along z, 0.098 along x, (0.08, 0.08) in x and z, 0.09 up and 0.09 down, offsets growing 0.05, 0.095 and 0.12 a tick along z and 0.07 a tick up (order drift) with corrections ignored, and 0.05 along z while walking

plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world (floor top at y -60), difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed, natural regeneration off; two bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5) and Viewer at (4.5,-60,4.5), which records BDS's copy of Subject from the MovePlayer relays; script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py; /tp of Subject by 0.05, 0.3 and 0.6 blocks along z, the client following, ignoring it (with corrections ignored) or following 10 inputs late, and a /tp 10 blocks up followed

plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world (floor top at y -60), difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed, natural regeneration off; two bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5) and Viewer at (4.5,-60,4.5), which records BDS's copy of Subject from the MovePlayer relays; script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py; Subject reporting its position offset from its own simulation (order offset DX DY DZ, thousandths) on the horizontal axes and the height independently, corrections ignored: x 0.05 with the height 3 up, 0.3 up, 3 down; x 0.3 with the height 0.05 and 3 up; x and z 0.08 and x 0.11 with the height 3 up; walking (move 1 0) with x 0.05 and the height 3 and 0.3 up; a /tp back to the start between phases

columns.inputs: tick, x, y, z (the reported eyes), pitch, yaw, strafe, forward, flags
columns.relays: tick, x, y, z, on_ground of BDS's copy after that input
columns.corrections: tick, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, on_ground
columns.teleports: tick of the input it followed, x, y, z

tp_follow.note: A /tp 8 blocks: the input already on its way is corrected to the destination at rest, the next says HandledTeleport there.

tp_late_5_walking.note: Walking while a /tp is followed five inputs late.

tp_ignore_uncorrected.note: A /tp never followed and corrections ignored: corrected every sixth input, BDS keeps the player at the destination and walks it there.

respawn_ignored.note: A respawn whose position the client ignores: the input after it is simulated from the spawn and corrected.

offset_z_0_2.note: Reporting 0.2 ahead: pulled ten inputs, corrected on the eleventh.

offset_xz_0_4.note: Reporting (0.4, 0.4) away: the pull is 0.005 long along the diagonal.

offset_1_uncorrected.note: Reporting 1.0 ahead, corrections ignored: corrected every sixth input.

offset_0_3_uncorrected.note: Reporting 0.3 ahead, corrections ignored: pulled, corrected, quiet, pulled, taken.

speed.note: Reporting 0.4 a tick east with forward input: BDS walks its copy.

phase_wall.note: Reporting 0.2 a tick through a wall: BDS stops at it.

step_hack.note: Reporting a 1-block rise onto a step.

fly.note: Hovering 5 blocks up: BDS's copy falls and lands hurt.

nofall.note: A 10-block fall claiming vertical collision every input: hurt 7.

slow_descent_uncorrected.note: A slow descent claimed while falling 10 blocks, corrections ignored: hurt 7.

offset_z_0_11.note: Reporting 0.11 ahead: pulled twice, taken, then pulled by its own remainder.

offset_y_minus_0_09.note: Reporting 0.09 into the floor: never taken.

drift_z_0_05.note: Drifting 0.05 a tick ahead, corrections ignored.

drift_z_0_095.note: Drifting 0.095 a tick ahead, corrections ignored.

tp_0_05_ignored.note: A /tp of 0.05 ignored: pulled back to the old position.

tp_0_3_ignored.note: A /tp of 0.3 ignored: pulled, corrected, pulled, taken back.

split_x_up_3.note: x 0.05 off, the height 3 up: x taken, the height kept, corrected every sixth input.

split_x_up_0_3.note: x 0.05 off, the height 0.3 up (inside the threshold): BDS takes the whole position, then lets its copy fall back.

split_x_0_3_up_0_05.note: x 0.3 off, the height 0.05 up: pulled, the eleventh disagreement corrected.

split_x_0_3_up_3.note: x 0.3 off, the height 3 up: nothing taken, corrected every sixth input.

split_xz_up_3.note: x and z 0.08 off (0.113 across), the height 3 up: x and z taken.

split_x_0_11_up_3.note: x 0.11 off, the height 3 up: x not taken.

split_x_down_3.note: x 0.05 off, the height 3 down (inside the ground): x taken.

split_walking_x_up_3.note: Walking with x 0.05 off and the height 3 up: x and z taken every input, the height kept.

split_walking_x_up_0_3.note: Walking with x 0.05 off and the height 0.3 up.
